incidents.title: Elevated errors for image generation
incidents.message: We have identified the issue affecting image generation in ChatGPT and the Images API. Some image-generation requests may continue to fail.

incidents.title: File uploads are delayed or failing
incidents.title_zh: File uploads are delayed or failing
incidents.message: We have identified the issue causing file-upload processing failures and delays in ChatGPT. Some files may remain unavailable while processing, and some uploads may fail.
